DICEY.Settings.Title: Things Got Dicey settings
DICEY.Settings.MenuHint: Holiday dice and how Dicey shows in Dicer's theme browser.
DICEY.Settings.Note: Your settings, on this device. Your GM may set some for everyone.
DICEY.Settings.NoteGM: Your settings, on this device. Everyone sets how much say players have.
DICEY.Settings.EveryoneHint: Player's choice, your value as their default, or your value locked.
DICEY.Settings.DefaultByGM: Your GM's default. You can change it.
DICEY.Settings.ChangedElsewhere: Changed elsewhere while this window was open.
DICEY.Settings.holidayDice.Name: Holiday dice
DICEY.Settings.holidayDice.Hint: Your dice switch to a holiday set while one is in season, and switch back after.
DICEY.Settings.holidayPick.Name: Which holiday set
DICEY.Settings.holidayPick.Hint: Random: a new set each time you load. Featured: the newest holiday's main set.
DICEY.Settings.holidaySkip.Name: Holidays to use
DICEY.Settings.holidaySkip.Hint: Untick a holiday to skip it. ★ marks holidays in season.
DICEY.Settings.holidaysInAll.Name: Holiday sets in All only in season
DICEY.Settings.holidaysInAll.Hint: The Holidays tab always shows every set.
DICEY.Settings.inSeasonFirst.Name: In-season sets near the top of All
DICEY.Settings.inSeasonFirst.Hint: After the sets you already use.
DICEY.Settings.screenFx.Name: Screen effects
DICEY.Settings.screenFx.Hint: Drawn across the screen on a natural 20 or 1: Christmas lights in a pine garland and the wreck Krampus leaves of them, menorah candles, falling leaves, snow and gelt, splats and a spinning dreidel. Holds still when your system asks for reduced motion.
DICEY.Settings.quietPets.Name: Quiet dice pets on Dicey sets
DICEY.Settings.quietPets.Hint: Your Dicer pet stays silent while a Dicey set with its own sounds is rolling, so the sounds do not pile up. Its antics still show. Takes effect after a reload.
DICEY.Settings.fxSound.Name: Effect sounds
DICEY.Settings.fxSound.Hint: The sounds of the screen effects: the wreck, the menorah. Off keeps the pictures and drops the sound. Jingles have their own switch. A set's own dice sounds (splats, coins, chimes) follow Dicer's sound settings instead.
DICEY.Settings.jingles.Name: Jingles
DICEY.Settings.jingles.Hint: The short tune a Christmas set plays on a natural 20. Everyone at the table hears the same one; off, you hear none.
DICEY.Settings.ledDice.Name: Blinking LEDs in dice
DICEY.Settings.ledDice.Hint: Small lights that blink inside some holiday dice. Takes effect after a reload. Starts off on Low dice quality.
DICEY.Settings.ResetAllHint: Resets every field. Nothing is saved until you click Save.
DICEY.Welcome.Title: Things Got Dicey
DICEY.Welcome.Intro: Holiday dice and effects, as set at this table. Change them here or any time later.
DICEY.Welcome.NoneInSeason: No holiday is in season right now.
DICEY.Welcome.Foot: More choices are in Dicey settings: which holidays to use, screen effects and their sounds, LEDs in the dice, and what shows in the theme browser.
DICEY.Settings.NoDicer: Dicer is not active in this world.
DICEY.Test.Title: Dicey effects test
DICEY.Test.Heading: Effects test
DICEY.Test.Note: Try Dicey's effects as they play in a game. Test rolls go to chat for you only, unless you tick Everyone.
DICEY.Test.FullHint: Rolls a d20 with a random set that plays this effect, fixed to the result it needs: the dice, their sounds and the screen effect, as in a game. Your own dice set is put back after the roll.
DICEY.Test.BySetHint: A d20 with this set, fixed to a natural 20, a natural 1, or anything between.
DICEY.Test.OnlyHint: The picture and its sound, with no roll. splat-small sits beside the last roll's dice.
DICEY.Test.JinglesHint: Each tune on its own, as it plays on a natural 20. Follows the Jingles switch.
DICEY.Test.Busy: A test roll is still playing.
DICEY.Test.Failed: The test roll failed; see the console.
DICEY.Test.GMOnly: The effects test is for GMs.
